source: XCUITest accessibility queries (SwiftUI AX not exposed via simulator-server native-devtools on iOS 26)

elements.memory-detail-translation-toggle: Button, label varies 'Show translation'/'Show original', value 'Original shown'/'Translation shown'
elements.memory-detail-translation-retry: Button 'Retry', shown in L2 error state
elements.translated_body: Static text 'Translated · en-US' + translated text (fixture 'orange tabby')
elements.low_confidence_original: Static text 'Original: <source text>' retained when confidence < 0.7

verification.high_confidence_journey: toggle -> translation shown -> toggle back to original (XCUITest passed)
verification.low_confidence_journey: toggle -> original retained + language label (XCUITest passed)
verification.error_journey: toggle -> L2 error + retry button (XCUITest passed)
